en.headline: HKU holds undergraduate information day highlighting AI and new programmes
en.dek: The campus event runs until 6 p.m. under the theme Shape a More Sustainable World with AI, and the university has proposed two new bachelor’s programmes for 2027-28.
body: The University of Hong Kong is holding its Information Day for Undergraduate Admissions 2026 on campus on Saturday, offering talks, tours and interactive sessions for JUPAS and non-JUPAS applicants and their families.

The event, running from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., carries the theme “Shape a More Sustainable World with AI”. Faculties are showing how artificial intelligence is integrated across disciplines from computing and engineering to arts, humanities, business, medicine, law and science, according to the university.

HKU has announced plans for two new undergraduate programmes in the 2027-28 academic year, subject to approval. The Faculty of Arts proposes a Bachelor of Arts Elite Programme (code 6133) offering flexible interdisciplinary humanities training with pathways to master’s courses at the Geneva Graduate Institute and Peking University’s Yenching Academy. The Faculty of Engineering proposes a Bachelor of Engineering in Robotics Engineering (code 6365), a four-year interdisciplinary course jointly offered by four departments and featuring a Hong Kong–Shanghai study pathway.

zh.headline: 港大本科入學資訊日今日舉行 聚焦AI跨學科應用並推介新課程
zh.dek: 活動以「啟航未來·AI共創可持續世界」為主題，校方計劃於2027-28學年推出文學士精英及機器人工程學兩項新本科課程，正待審批。
body: 香港大學今日在校園舉行2026年本科入學資訊日，為有意循聯招及非聯招途徑報讀的學生及家長提供課程介紹、招生講座及設施參觀。
活動由上午9時至下午6時，主題為「Shape a More Sustainable World with AI」。各學院展示人工智能如何融入文科、人文、商學、醫學、法律及理學等多個領域，據港大資料。
港大宣布計劃於2027-28學年推出兩項全新本科課程，目前正待審批。文學院的文學士精英課程（編號6133）提供彈性跨學科人文訓練，並設通往日內瓦國際關係及發展高等學院及北京大學燕京學堂等碩士途徑。工程學院的工學學士（機器人工程學）（編號6365）由四個學系聯合開辦，設香港–上海雙城學習規劃。
